title: Iblis refuses to bow to Adam
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Iblis refuses to bow to Adam, about mythic at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Shayan refused to bow before Allah's creation, namely Adam

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani retells an old religious story from Islam: Iblis, also called Shaytan, the figure known as Satan, refused to bow down before Adam, the first man God created. In Jorjani's telling this refusal is a key moment in the story of how humans and other kinds of beings came to stand against each other.
